about.title: About Peoria Unified School District
about.content: Peoria Unified School District serves families in the Phoenix West Valley. Its calendar is especially important for household planning because the district starts before many out-of-state calendars, marks modified Wednesdays separately from other early-release dates, and identifies elementary conference dates, high school early-release days, furlough/no-school days, and teacher workdays.

about.title: District Calendar and Campus Schedules
about.content: This page summarizes districtwide Peoria Unified dates. Families should still check their school for bell schedules, bus routes, testing, athletics, performances, graduation ceremony details, rotation-day schedules, and emergency updates.

planningTips.title: Peoria Unified Calendar Notes
content: Peoria Unified often starts before Labor Day, with students starting in late July or early August depending on the year.
Modified Wednesdays are two-hour early-release days, but not every Wednesday follows the modified schedule.
Elementary conference dates and high school early-release indicators do not always affect every grade band the same way.
Use the separate 5-day or 6-day rotation calendar only if your campus or program follows one of those rotation schedules.

districtFaqs.q: Does Peoria Unified start before Labor Day?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Peoria Unified often starts before Labor Day. For 2026–27, classes begin on Monday, August 3, 2026.

districtFaqs.q: What is a modified Wednesday on the Peoria Unified calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Modified Wednesdays are two-hour early-release days on the PUSD calendar. Not every Wednesday follows that schedule, so families should confirm exact dismissal times with their school.

districtFaqs.q: Are Peoria Unified teacher workdays student attendance days?
districtFaqs.a: No. Teacher workdays shown on the PUSD calendar are no-school days for students.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Peoria Unified calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Peoria Unified school-year calendars page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Peoria Unified School District.
